root_checks.general_checks_scope: Separate repository checks; focused test and independent review results are bound above. Acquisition/publication commands were dry runs.

accepted_scope: Eight test groups, 384 MCC single-byte mutations, 25 compiled assertion mutants and 486 independent cases pass; 69 golden NPS wires match.

All six source classes derive from supplied immutable bytes. Full 384-byte MCC semantics are required. Named VRAM uses its full declared allocation extent, with valid visible geometry inside it and chosen DRAM.
Original 736-byte and native 1152-byte profiles are explicit. Native RAM high is preserved; the retained prefix rounds outward without shrinking source guards.

Measurement precedes final native encoding. Production rederives the measurement, binds actual supplied byte hashes, then uses the reviewed pure handoff002 planner. No allocation resize or target write exists.
limits: Initial null/unaligned framebuffer and VRAM-outside-DRAM false acceptances were corrected before freezing; exact reproductions are preserved. Mutation-selector failures were harness failures and are not counted as semantic kills.
The historical 80-byte MCC list cannot stand in for 384 bytes. Missing historical final native wire is not reconstructed.
Trusted caller image labels and copied source bytes do not establish freshness, authentication, global coverage, live VM ownership or policy authority.
hardware_decision: STOP003 remains. Last recorded state is verified Linux. No SSH, boot, reset, deployment or native API execution in this admission. Shared APCIE PHY/PMGR writes remain compiled out; GPU held; serial bridge stopped; no Signal.
next_step: Isolated source integration and bounded private observer design only. A separately reviewed concrete packet is required before any hardware decision.
